# stb (vendored)

Single-file public-domain / MIT libraries by Sean Barrett, used by the macOS SDL
gxRuntime: `stb_image.h` (LoadImage, textures) and `stb_truetype.h` (fonts).

Source: https://github.com/nothings/stb at commit 6b5799bae8a1fe3792691ef4b72ae26434c3e799
